title: The sphere's count has a unary Sherali-Adams refutation of degree 3
claim: For the octahedral knot sphere K_k (n = 4k^2 points), the sum over lines of the two clause-falsifying conjunctions minus the sum over the n - 4 three-point faces of two complementary conjunctions is the constant polynomial 1. This is a Sherali-Adams refutation of the not-all-equal formula of degree 3 with 4n - 8 terms, all coefficients +1 or -1, so by Goos-Hollender-Jain-Maystre-Pires-Robere-Tao (unary Sherali-Adams captures PPADS^dt) finding a violated line is in PPADS^dt; with FLAT-STATES-20261107-001B it lies between one-sided 2D Sperner and PPADS. Solver record (experiment): a cutting-planes solver (Exact) and an XOR-reasoning solver (CryptoMiniSat) scale no better than plain CDCL (CaDiCaL) on K_2..K_7.
failure_conditions: A line or face identity that fails, or a sum of terms different from the constant 1 on some K_k.
A positive term that is not a falsifying conjunction of a clause of the formula, or a coefficient other than +1 or -1.
A misreading of the Goos et al. characterization (it requires polylog-width formulas, polylog degree and quasipolynomial size).
foundation_claim_scope: The octahedral knot spheres K_k for every k (by the proof; the identity checked on K_2..K_8). Solver behaviour recorded on K_2..K_7 only.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-11-07.
validation.status: the identity by hand, symbolically checked on K_2..K_8 and by brute force on K_2; the PPADS placement by citation; the solver record is experiment evidence; no human or external review
validation.novelty: known-with-delta: the Euler count is known upstream (Sherali-Adams level 3); the unary coefficient bound and hence PPADS^dt membership for these formulas, and the solver record, are new as far as found.
